title: Privacy notice
intro: How we use your information. Short version: as little as possible.
body:
## Who we are

Knightlight Books is run by Hallam Knight, a sole trader. Contact: {{email}}, {{address}}.

## What we collect and why

- **Reading list and "Notify me"**: your email address and the genres or books you choose, so we can email you about them. We use Kit (ConvertKit) to send these emails. You can unsubscribe at any time from any email.
- **Contact form**: your name, email and message, so we can reply. Messages are stored by our website host, Netlify.
- **Purchases**: Payhip processes your payment and delivers your file. We receive your name, email and order details for our records and tax purposes. We never see your card details.
- **Visit counts**: we count page views without cookies, IP addresses or any personal data.

## Your choices on this device

If you confirm your age to enter the Romance section, we remember that choice in your browser's local storage on that device only. Clearing your browser data removes it.

## How long we keep it

Reading list details until you unsubscribe. Contact messages for up to 12 months. Order records for 6 years, as required for tax.

## Your rights

You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or object to how we use it. Email {{email}}. If you're unhappy, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk).
